power.neoorigins.kraken_deep_current.des: Dabaasha aad uga dheereeya qof kasta oo dusha deggan.
power.neoorigins.kraken_pressure_armor.d: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - maqaar-badeed qoto dheer oo loo dhisay cadaadiska.
power.neoorigins.kraken_regen_in_water.d: Waxay bogsiisaa 2 HP ilbiriqsikii marka aad biyaha ku jirto.
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.name: Xeeb leh
power.neoorigins.kraken_beached.descript: 30% si tartiib tartiib ah ugu dhaqaaqa dhulka - aan loo dhisin socod.
Waxay qaadataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
U yeedh mas'uul inuu kuu dagaalamo. Max 2 hal mar. Waxay ku kacaysaa 5 nuxur.20-ilbiriqsi qaboojin. Waxa aad qaadanaysaa 1 dhaawac haddii uu ku dhinto dagaalka.
power.neoorigins.kraken_massive.name: Weyn
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.name: Wuu qallalaa
power.neoorigins.kraken_dries_out.descri: Hawadu way soo dhacaysaa marka aad biyo ka maqan tahay: oogada aad bay u dheer tahay oo waad ku neef qabataa. Roobka, digsi-biyoodka, Neefsashada biyaha ama marin-biyoodka firfircoon ee u dhow ayaa dhammaan demiya.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_summon_guardian: U yeedh mas'uul inuu kuu dagaalamo. Max 2 hal mar. Waxay ku kacaysaa 5 nuxur.20-ilbiriqsi qaboojin. Waxa aad qaadanaysaa 1 dhaawac haddii uu ku dhinto dagaalka.
origins.neoorigins.warden.name: Waardiye
origins.neoorigins.warden.description: Waxa uu ka dhashay mugdiga qoto dheer - waxa uu dunida ku dareemaa gariir, waxa uu sii daayaa kor u kaca sonic ee kala duwan, oo uu u garaaco sida wan garaacis ah. Lumbering iyo xanuunka iftiinka qoraxda.
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.name: Qarax Sonic
power.neoorigins.warden_sonic_boom.descr: Dabayaa qarax sonic ah oo ba'an (8 dhaawac sixir + gaabis III ee aag 10-block ah). Waxay ku kacaysaa 4 adkeysi20-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.warden_echolocation.des: Nolol dhow ayaa dhalaalaya, oo laga dhex arki karo xitaa gidaarada.
power.neoorigins.warden_tremor_sense.des: Dareema meelaha fog - 2 ilbiriqsi kasta, wax kasta oo ku jira 24 blocks ayaa dhalaalaya 3 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.name: Xooga Madaw
power.neoorigins.warden_strength.descrip: Waxay fulisaa 4 dhaawac dheeraad ah garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.warden_ancient_hide.des: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah II - hilibka asaasiga ah iyo lakabka cufan ee cufan ayaa iska indha tiraya waxyeelada ugu badan.
power.neoorigins.warden_night_vision.des: Wuxuu aduunka ku arkaa gariir - gudcurku ma khuseeyo.
Waxay qaadataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka ay soo gaarto iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.name: Alwaax dhigid
power.neoorigins.warden_lumbering.descri: 30% ayuu ka gaabiyaa sidii caadiga ahayd - waa xoog wax baabi'in kara laakiin wax maleegaya.
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Ciirsi
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: Farsamoyaqaan aad u adag oo dhulka hoostiisa ah - is haysta, gaashaaman, oo aan daalin xagga foornada, laakiin lugaha gaaban oo gaabis ah dusha sare.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_compact_frame.des: 80% cabbirka ciyaartoyga caadiga ah - wuxuu ku habboon yahay meelo cidhiidhi ah.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stout_constitutio: Iska caabin joogta ah I - muruq iyo lafo cufan si fudud kuma soo baxaan.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.name: Madaw
power.neoorigins.dwarf_darkvision.descri: Waxa si cad wax looga arki karaa gudcurka guud - cimriga oo dhan dhulka hoostiisa. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.name: Lugaha Adag
power.neoorigins.dwarf_sturdy_legs.descr: Dhaqdhaqaaqa 15% gaabis ah - lugaha gaaban laakiin fadhiya.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.name: Dhagxaan
power.neoorigins.dwarf_stonecunning.desc: Waxay jebiyaa 25% dhaqsiyo badan - gacmaha lagu dhaqmo shay kasta.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.name: Gacmaha Gaaban
power.neoorigins.dwarf_short_reach.descr: Xadka isdhexgalka xannibaadda waxaa hoos u dhacay 0.5 - gacmo gaaban, xajin xooggan.
power.neoorigins.dwarf_mining_hunger.des: Wuxuu isticmaalaa 25% gaajo ka yar dhammaan waxqabadyada - loo dhisay dulqaad.
La siiyay birta dwarven pickaxe (Unbreaking II, Efficiency I) markaad dooranayso asalkan.
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: Neecaw
origins.neoorigins.breeze.description: Makhluuqa dabaysha oo ku dhashay Qolalka Tijaabada - dhakhso badan, hawo qaada, oo ku hubaysan gusts, laakiin khafiif ah oo jilicsan.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.name: Kharashka Dabaysha
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_charge.desc: Wuxuu bilaabay madfac dabaysha oo dib u soo celinaysa cadawga.5-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.name: Dabaysha Dabaysha
power.neoorigins.breeze_wind_dash.descri: Horey ugu soo burqataa duufaan dabayl wadata.4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: La beddeli karo: dabayshu way ku qabanaysaa markaad dhacayso. Daar ahaan - ku dami furaha xirfadda si aad u dejiso hits muhiim ah.
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.name: Dib u habeyn
power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: La beddeli karo: dabaylaha ayaa kor u qaadaya boodboodkaada (Jump Boost II). Daar ahaan - ku dami furaha xirfadda haddii aad rabto dhererka boodboodka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.name: Dabayl dabayl
power.neoorigins.breeze_speed_boost.desc: Dhaqso 15% u dhaqaaqa - dabayshu ayaa hore kuu soo riixaysa.
power.neoorigins.breeze_reduced_health.d: -4 wadne (-8 max HP). Jirka dabayshu waa jidh sinaba.
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.name: Qaabka Iftiinka
power.neoorigins.breeze_light_frame.desc: 90% cabbirka ciyaaryahan caadi ah — iftiin iyo hawo leh.
origins.neoorigins.vampire.name: Vampire
origins.neoorigins.vampire.description: Ugaadhsade aan dhiman ee habeenkii - dhaqsaha badan, xoog badan, iyo gaajo weligeed ah. Iftiinka qorraxdu waa xanuun, biyuhu waa gubanayaan, hilib cayriin oo keliya ayaa ku quudiya.
power.neoorigins.vampire_entity_group.de: Lagu sifeeyay mid aan dhimanWaxyeeleeyey Caafimaadka degdega ah, waxaa bogsiiyey Burbur degdeg ah, oo ka difaaca Sunta.
power.neoorigins.vampire_water_breathing: Uma baahna inuu neefsado. Wuxuu ku noolaan karaa ilaa xad aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.vampire_night_vision.de: Waxa uu si cad wax uga arki karaa gudcurka guud. Ku beddel furaha Aragtida Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.vampire_attack_bonus.de: Waxay fulisaa 2 dhaawac dheeraad ah garaac kasta.
power.neoorigins.vampire_speed_boost.des: Dhaqso 15% u dhaqaaqa - blur iftiinka dayaxa.
power.neoorigins.vampire_daylight_damage: Dab qabsaday oo 2 dhaawac ku qaada ilbiriqsikiiba iftiinka qorraxda tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.name: Muhiimadda Maydka
power.neoorigins.vampire_slow_regen.desc: Dib u soo kabashada caafimaadka dabiiciga ah ayaa hoos loo dhigay ilaa 40% ee caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.vampire_food_restrictio: Waxa kaliya oo cuni kara hilibka ceeriin, hilib qudhunsan, iyo indhaha caarada.
power.neoorigins.vampire_blood_diet_bonu: Hilib ceeriin iyo qudhuntay ayaa ku quudiya sidii mid cusub oo la kariyey.
Wuxuu qaataa 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii inta lagu jiro biyo ama roob.
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.name: Bahal dameer
origins.neoorigins.monster_tamer.descrip: Dugaag aan cabsi lahayn oo mooryaanta cadawga ah u laabta rabitaankooda. Keligood waa tabardaran yihiin, laakiin iyaga oo garabkooda ku jira xidhid daacad ah, waa xoog la isku halleyn karo.
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.name: Mamul
power.neoorigins.tamer_tame_mob.descript: Fiiri mooryaan cadawtinimo oo dhaqaaji si aad u laaciso doonistaada. Way ku raacaysaa oo ku difaaci doontaa. Max 4 rabbeeyay mob. Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 nuxur.10-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.name: Sida 'Em
power.neoorigins.tamer_command_pack.desc: Eeg bartilmaameedka oo dhaqaaji si aad u amarto xidhmadaada oo dhan si aad u weerarto.2-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.name: Xidhiidhka Kooxda
power.neoorigins.tamer_horde_regen.descr: Kooxahaagii la rabey ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah dib ugu soo celiya 1 HP 6dii sekenba mar inta ay ka maqan yihiin dagaalka.
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.name: Daciifnimo kali ah
power.neoorigins.tamer_weak_alone.descri: Wax ka qabashada 25% ka yar dhaawaca melee - waxaad ku tiirsan tahay xirmadaada si aad ula dagaallanto.
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.name: Quudi Xidhmada
power.neoorigins.tamer_hunger_drain.desc: Gaajo ayaa 50% dhaqso uga soo baxda culayska ilaalinta curaartaada.
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.not_enough_hun: Gaajo ku filan oo la rabbeeyo!
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.not_hostile: Kaliya ma rari kartaa mooryaanta cadawga ah!
power.neoorigins.tame_mob.no_resource: Aan ku filnayn awood lagu rabbeeyo!
power.neoorigins.mount.no_target: Ma jiro cid ku jirta xadka.
power.neoorigins.mount.already_ridden: Kooxdaas ayaa hore u haysatay qof fuushan!
power.neoorigins.mount.request_sent: Codsiga kor u qaadista ayaa loo diray %s.
power.neoorigins.mount.accepted_requeste: %s wuu aqbalay codsigaagii kor u qaadista!
power.neoorigins.mount.declined_requeste: %s waa diiday codsigaagii kor u qaadida.
power.neoorigins.mount.expired: Codsiga kor u qaadida ayaa dhacay
power.neoorigins.mount.no_request: Ma haysatid codsiyo buur oo sugaya
power.neoorigins.mount.requester_offline: Ciyaaryahanka codsanaya hadda ma joogo onlayn.
power.neoorigins.mount.too_far: Ciyaaryahanka codsanaya aad buu u fog yahay.
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.name: Dhulka Mage
origins.neoorigins.earth_mage.descriptio: geomancer-ka adag oo dhulka ku dhufanaya si uu cadawga u kala jeexo oo darbiyo dhagax ah u taago istimaal. Waa sida buur oo kale, laakiinse dhulku wuu isku dhow yahay, Biyaha iyo meelaha dhaadheerna saaxiibbo ma aha.
Dhulka ku dhufo, adigoo wax ka qabanaya 6 dhaawac oo dib u garaacaya dhammaan meelaha u dhow. Qiimaha 3 mana6-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_stone_wall.d: Dhig meel dhagax-dhagax ka samaysan meesha aad ka eegayso.2-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.name: Xididday
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_rooted.descr: Qaado 50% kayar dhabar-jabka - u adag sidii sariir.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.name: Culus
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_heavy.descri: Ma dabaalan karo - waxaad u degtaa sida dhagax oo kale.
power.neoorigins.earth_mage_earthbound.d: Qaado 50% dhaawac dheeraad ah oo dhicis ah. Dhulku tiisa ayuu soo ceshadaa.
origins.neoorigins.water_mage.name: Biyaha Mage
